headline: Kenya Prepares Crude Oil Drilling Operations in South Lokichar
summary: Kenya is readying crude oil drilling in South Lokichar in Turkana as it aims to join Uganda and South Sudan as an East African petroleum exporter.
why: Commercial crude development provides essential foreign exchange earnings for developing East African nations.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Starting domestic oil extraction diversification improves foreign exchange revenues.
